cards.text: That same day, Jesus heads out of the house and sits down by the sea. Then the crowds come, and friend, these are LARGE crowds. So many people that Jesus needs a new place to sit.

cards.question: With large crowds gathering around Him by the sea, where does Jesus go to sit down?

cards.text: Into a boat He goes, while all the people stand on the shore. Then He tells them many things in parables, starting with a farmer who goes out to sow his seed.

cards.question: As the farmer sows, some seed falls along the path, and the ___ come and devour it.

cards.text: Those birds devour that seed faster than the Millers, the family I used to live with, cleared a fresh batch off the counter. Next, some seed falls on rocky ground, where there isn't much soil.

cards.question: The seed on the rocky ground, where the soil is shallow, is slow to come up.

cards.text: It springs up quickly because the soil is shallow. Friend, that little sprout looks like a total WINNER.

cards.question: When the sun rises, the seedlings on the rocky ground get scorched.
The seedlings on the rocky ground wither in the sun. What does Jesus say they were missing?

cards.text: Other seed falls among thorns. Friend, this farmer tosses seed the way I toss sprinkles: EVERYWHERE.

cards.question: In the thorny patch, the thorns grow up and ___ the seedlings.

cards.text: Path, rocks, thorns. This farmer is 0 for 3, friend, but still other seed falls on good soil.

cards.question: The seed on good soil produces a crop. How big does that crop get?

answers.text: Up to a hundred times over

cards.text: Then Jesus says, "He who has ears, let him hear." That's the ending, friend, like getting a text that just says 'call me' and NOTHING else.
Then Jesus' disciples, the ones following Him and learning from Him, come to Him. Friend, they've got a QUESTION.

cards.question: When the disciples come to Jesus, what do they ask Him?

answers.text: Why He speaks to the people in parables
Why He teaches the crowd from a boat
Who the farmer in His story is

cards.text: Fair question, and Jesus starts His answer with the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven. Friend, I shared a drawer with a key that never figured out which door it opened, so when somebody starts talking MYSTERIES, I'm all ears.

cards.question: Jesus tells the disciples that the knowledge of the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven has been given to them, but not to the people.

cards.text: Then Jesus says whoever has will be given more, and he will have an abundance. Friend, that's like pulling one tray out of the oven and finding TWO more behind it.

cards.question: And whoever does not have? What does Jesus say happens to what he has?

cards.text: Now Jesus gets to the why of the parables, and it's all about eyes and ears.

cards.question: Jesus says the people are seeing and hearing. So why does He speak to them in parables?

answers.text: They do not truly see or understand
They have not heard enough stories
They are standing too far away

cards.text: Seeing without seeing, like me hunting the whole bakery for my chef's hat while it's ON MY HEAD. And Jesus says the prophecy of Isaiah, the prophet (Isaiah 6:9-10), is fulfilled in them.

cards.question: In Isaiah's prophecy, this people's heart has grown callous, and they hardly hear with their ears. And their eyes? They have ___ them.
Isaiah's prophecy says that if this people would see, hear, understand and turn, there would be healing for them.
Then Jesus speaks to His disciples about their own eyes and ears. What does He say?

answers.text: They are blessed because they see and hear
They are closed just like the crowd's
They will see and hear only much later

cards.text: Blessed eyes, blessed ears. Then Jesus tells them about the prophets and righteous men who came before.

cards.question: Jesus says many prophets and righteous men got to see and hear what the disciples are seeing and hearing.

cards.text: They longed to see it and did not see it, and the disciples have it right in front of them. Friend, that's a FRONT ROW seat.
Then Jesus tells them to consider the parable of the sower, and friend, that 'call me' text finally gets its PHONE CALL!

cards.question: The seed on the path is someone who hears the message of the kingdom. Who comes and snatches away what was sown in his heart?

cards.text: The evil one snatches it away. Next up, the seed on rocky ground, and that's someone who hears the word.

cards.question: The one on the rocky ground at once receives the word with joy.

cards.text: At once, with JOY, friend, the way I light up every single time that oven timer DINGS. But he has no root.

cards.question: When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, the one on the rocky ground quickly ___.

cards.text: Next, the seed among the thorns: that's the one who hears the word. But the worries of this life and the deceitfulness of wealth choke the word.

cards.question: In the one sown among the thorns, the choked word becomes ___.
Last up, the seed on good soil: the one who hears the word. What else does he do with the word?

cards.text: He bears fruit, a hundredfold, sixtyfold or thirtyfold, and if one scoop of my dough made a HUNDRED cookies, I'd need a bigger planet. That's where we'll leave the farmer for now, friend, but Jesus isn't done talking about the kingdom.
